title: v1.5.4: Remove autotune, add 12-band EQ detail panel, convolver reverb with reverse mode
body: ## Summary Remove autotune entirely, replace with 12-band EQ detail panel (Q knobs + dynamic EQ toggles), add convolver reverb module with FL Studio-style reverse mode. **Key changes:** - Deleted PitchEngine and all autotune params/UI - 12 Q bandwidth knobs + 12 Dynamic EQ toggle buttons (signal-responsive gain scaling) - Convolver reverb: synthetic IR generation, reverse mode, CPU-efficient (pre-allocated buffers, lazy rebuild) - 14 modules in 7+7 grid layout - All factory presets cleaned of autotune references, trap/rage presets enhanced with convolver - `resetToDefaults()` now resets ALL parameters (gate, output gains were previously missing) **Devin Review fixes (6 issues addressed):** - kConvolver added to silence recovery check (truncated reverb tails) - IR buffers pre-allocated in prepare() (no audio-thread heap allocs) - Dynamic EQ skipped for HP/LP/Notch filter types (gain unused = wasted CPU) - Separate `dynFilters[]` for dynamic EQ (no UI thread flicker) - Sidechain coefficients cached (updated on param change, not every block) - Dynamic biquad computed in-place via Audio EQ Cookbook formulas (zero allocs per block) ## Review & Testing Checklist for Human - [ ] Load plugin in FL Studio, verify all 14 module strips visible (7+7 rows) - [ ] Check EQ Detail Section: 12 Q knobs + 12 DYN buttons with frequency labels - [ ] Test Q knobs: turn them and verify EQ bandwidth changes on the curve display - [ ] Test DYN buttons: toggle on a bell band, verify gain responds to signal level - [ ] Test CONV module: enable, adjust Size/Mix, toggle Reverse — verify reverb effect - [ ] Load "Trap Dark & Wet" preset, verify reverse convolver sounds correct - [ ] Monitor CPU usage with multiple plugin instances — should stay low - [ ] Verify no autotune controls remain anywhere in the UI ### Notes CI passes on all 3 platforms (Windows, macOS, Linux). The convolver generates synthetic IRs algorithmically so no external WAV files are needed. Dynamic EQ only runs sidechain processing on bands where DYN is enabled. Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/746dfe41f17940fbb3bc85bc14e118f3 Requested by: @elijahjfrierson-prog ---
